issue_context.title: Remove net6.0;net7.0 from System.Numerics.Tensors
issue_context.body: In https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/92269 we re-enabled `net6.0;net7.0` to make it easier to backport changes from main to 8.0.  We should remove those before we ship 9.0 since these frameworks will be out of support by the time it ships. cc @ViktorHofer
